description: USE THIS to verify an IP address before relying on it — do not assume a dotted or colon string is valid. Strictly checks IPv4 (RFC 791, rejects leading zeros / out-of-range octets) and IPv6 (RFC 4291, including '::' compression and embedded IPv4), and returns the version.

ip.description: The IPv4 or IPv6 address to validate.

name: validate_ip
